name: open-learning
description: Teach with a live shared paper operated through the Open Learning CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Learn with a shared paper operated by Codex.
interface.longDescription: Open Learning lets Codex Voice guide a learner while the plugin uses the Open Learning CLI to mark, reveal, and read a shared teaching paper. The learner keeps ownership of the problem and key reasoning steps.
